# APPENDICITIS WITHOUT PERFORATION

[Oral step-down treatment](step-down-treatment)
Patients with an acutely inflamed appendix and no gangrene or perforation are considered to have uncomplicated appendicitis. Patients with gangrene, perforation, peritonitis, or abscess have complicated appendicitis. Treatment with antibiotics is an option for patients who are unfit for surgery or refuse surgery. Treatment with antibiotics should not be used routinely as an alternative to surgery.

References:

- Zagales et al, Am Surg 2023, 89:2644
- Huston et al, Surg Infect, 2024 doi: 10.1089/sur.2024.137 [ahead of print]
- Mandell chapter: Appendicitis
- Sanford Guide article: Appendicitis
- Solomkin et al, Clin Infect Dis, 2010, 50:133-64
- Up-to-Date article: Management of acute appendicitis in adults
Therapy:
### Select for treatment of complicated appendicitis

[Link to appendicitis with perforation menu](appendicitis-with-perforation)

### Treatment of uncomplicated appendicitis

Surgical management: Administer prophylaxis regimen below prior to surgery only. Stop antibiotics after the surgery.
Surgical prophylaxis:
Cefazolin weight-based dosing preop < AND > metronidazole 500 mg IV once Post-surgical: antibiotics not recommended after appendectomy

### Interval appendectomy or no appendectomy

Duration of therapy: Treat with antibiotics for 7 days total
Preferred:

### Inpatient/Outpatient

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]
Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
Alternative for severe Beta-lactam reaction:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

## ER/UC

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]
Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT [R]
Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV once STAT [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]
Alternative for severe Beta-lactam reaction:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
